title: Find your range in about a minute
intro: Sing or hum your lowest comfortable note and hold it, then do the same with your highest. Each note locks in once you hold it steady for about a second.
noMic: No microphone? Pick your notes on a keyboard
singLowHelp: Slide down slowly and stop on the lowest note that still sounds clear, not creaky. Then hold it. Humming works too.
singHighHelp: Go as high as you comfortably can without straining, and hold it there.
nowHigh: Got it. Take a breath, then sing your highest comfortable note.
fryHint: That sounds like vocal fry, which the test doesn't count. Come up a little, to a clear note.
whistleHint: Notes from {note} up are in the whistle register, which the test doesn't count. Sing your highest note below it.
aboveLowHint: Your highest note needs to be above {note}. Go a little higher.
holdSteady: Pick one note and hold it as steady as you can for about a second.
mayChange: Your range may change with warmup, training, and time of day.
breakMoreReliable: Your voice break is a more reliable indicator of voice type.
tooNarrow: Those notes are less than an octave apart, too close to compare with a voice type. Try again, going as low and as high as feels comfortable.
wideNote: Three octaves or more holds several voice types whole, so no single type is named.
fryFlag: Some vocal fry came in below {note}. It isn't counted in your range.
whistleFlag: Some notes came in from {note} up, in the whistle register. They aren't counted in your range.
manualNote: You picked these notes by hand.
keyboardRange: Piano keyboard with your range, {range}, marked
shareText: My vocal range is {range}. You can test yours for free in your browser:
shareTwoLines: The two lines are my own voice, held on my lowest and my highest note.
ctaAndroid: Your range: {range}. Enter it when you set up Scalita, and every warm-up starts and stops where your voice does. Free, offline, no account.
ctaIos: Your range: {range}. Scalita is an Android app for now, so save or share your result above to keep it.
ctaDesktop: Your range: {range}. Scalita is an Android app. Save or share your result above, and send yourself the link to open it on your phone.
pianoButton: Hear your range on the piano
pianoPlaying: Playing your lowest note, your highest, then a scale between them.
manualTitle: Pick your range on a keyboard
manualLow: Tap keys to hear them, then choose the lowest note you can sing comfortably.
manualHigh: Now choose the highest note you can sing comfortably.
